**1B.10 Research Note: Abiy Ahmed in 2024**

**Bottom line:** The 2024 record leaves a mixed but slightly negative balance. Abiy ended the year with a real de-escalatory diplomatic outcome on Somalia, and he repeatedly used peace-forward rhetoric. But he also opened the year with a destabilizing Somaliland port move and presided over ongoing emergency governance and violence in Amhara. On balance, Ethiopia’s existential-risk posture looks somewhat safer in regional diplomacy than it started, but more dangerous internally.

| Date | Title | Publisher | Recoverable page URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2024-02-06 | Ethiopia's leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port | Associated Press via CityNews | https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/ | Abiy said he had “no intention” of going to war with Somalia and framed peace as mutually beneficial, while also trying to reassure Egypt on the Nile dam issue. This is strong evidence of de-escalatory crisis communication. | 1B.10, 1B.8, 1B.2, 1B.1 |
| 2024-01-01 | Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland's Red Sea port | Reuters, republished by MarketScreener | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/ | The Berbera MOU tied Ethiopian access to possible naval use and recognition/concessions, and was widely treated as a major source of Horn of Africa tension. This is strong negative evidence early in the year. | 1B.10, 1B.8, 1B.4 |

This shows a dangerous internal-security posture, with heavy reliance on coercive emergency powers. | 1B.10, 1B.8, 1B.3, 7A.* |

This supports a safer posture than the January-February crisis period suggested. | 1B.10, 1B.8, 1B.2, 1B.4 |
| 2024-10-31 | Ethiopia Pursues Peaceful Access to Red Sea Amid Growing Economy: PM Abiy | ENA English | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5380659 | Abiy said Ethiopia sought Red Sea access “in a peaceful manner” and that the agenda was “not about confrontation.” This is further de-escalatory evidence. | 1B.10, 1B.8, 1B.2, 1B.4 |
| 2024-12-12 | Ethiopia-Somalia Ankara Declaration under facilitation of Republic of Türkiye | Republic of Türkiye Directorate of Communications | https://www.iletisim.gov.tr/English/haberler/detay/ethiopia-somalia-ankara-declaration-under-facilitation-of-republic-of-turkiye | Ethiopia and Somalia agreed to respect sovereignty, set aside disputes, and cooperate. This is the clearest sign that Abiy left the regional dispute safer than he found it. | 1B.10, 1B.8, 1B.4, 1B.1 |

**Short synthesis**

- Safer than inherited:
  - Somalia dispute ended the year de-escalated.
  - Public rhetoric repeatedly favored peace over confrontation.
- More dangerous than inherited:
  - The Somaliland port MOU raised Horn of Africa tensions early in the year.
  - Amhara remained violent and emergency-driven, with accountability concerns.
- Net judgment:
  - Regionally, slightly safer by year-end.
  - Domestically, still dangerous.
